text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the desk in the Trainer's office. I 
gaze at the wallet placed there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only just realized I had dropped it. I 
closed my eyes and groaned quietly, trying 
to remember where it could have slipped 
away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I opened my eyes, it was sitting on 
the desk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words slip out before I realize it, 
but that can't be. Someone must have 
placed it here for me. ……Without me even 
noticing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping out into the hallway, I caught a 
fleeting glimpse of Still in Love. Could 
it be that she was the one...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly gave chase, but there was 
already no sign of her. She should have 
turned right around this corner just now――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
........ I am so sorry. I didn't mean to 
startle you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I didn't intend for it to happen, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't sensed their presence at all... 
Trying to compose myself first, I asked 
about the wallet. And then――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I saw you drop it... so I came to 
return it to you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer's office door was open... and 
since you seemed to be asleep, I just 
placed it on your desk and...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I should have spoken up sooner. Forgive 
me for acting so suspiciously—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Intending to express thanks, but on the 
verge of receiving an apology instead, I 
hastily tried to cut inââ
choice_data_list: Was it too fast for the eye to catch?
You didn't make a single sound!
You didn't make a single sound!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Intending to express thanks, but on the 
verge of receiving an apology instead, I 
hastily tried to cut inââ
choice_data_list: Was it too fast for the eye to catch?
You didn't make a single sound!
You didn't make a single sound!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...How is this? I intended to finish up 
swiftly so as not to disturb your sleep, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I really should have spoken up. She seemed 
to be tossing and turning in the throes of 
a nightmare, after all...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Next time, if something similar happens... 
I think... I'll be more careful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I was asleep, but... Even 
standing right before my eyes, her 
presence is so faint... What a truly 
mysterious girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I told her she saved the day, Still 
in Love let out a soft smile. In that 
moment, I felt as though I could finally 
sense her true presence vividly.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, people often tell me... that they 
can't sense my presence, or that I fade 
into the background...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I startled you. I should have 
at least left a note saying I found it 
before leaving it behind.
choice_data_list: I'm fine, you really saved me! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... Hearing such words of gratitude 
makes me the happier one...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However... I believe it would be best to 
keep the door firmly shut from now on...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...So that no uninvited guests slip 
inside...
